trace.cypher: MATCH (p:Player)-[:MentionedIn]->(:Document), (p)-[r:PlaysFor]->(t:Team) WHERE p.nationality <> 'German' AND CAST(p.olympic_gold_medals AS INT64) > 0 AND CAST(p.olympic_gold_medals AS INT64) <> 0 AND CAST(p.mvp_awards AS INT64) = 0 AND r.tenure = 'latest' RETURN DISTINCT p.nationality AS col1, p.draft_pick AS col2, t.team_name AS col3, p.name AS name_player

MATCH (p:Player)-[:MentionedIn]->(:Document) WHERE p.nationality <> 'German' AND CAST(p.olympic_gold_medals AS INT64) > 0 AND CAST(p.mvp_awards AS INT64) = 0 OPTIONAL MATCH (p)-[:PlaysFor]->(t:Team) RETURN p.nationality AS col1, p.draft_pick AS col2, t.team_name AS col3, p.name AS name_player
